assumptions.statement: Detailed statutory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, building surveys and engineering constraints require official or professionally cleared evidence.
assumptions.impact: The package is a formal reviewable design submission but not a statutory plan, construction document or approval.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All location, area and ratio outputs must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Repository discussion records a location conflict between the provisional overall polygon and a publicly mapped heritage park.
assumptions.impact: The proposal avoids parcel-level and exact heritage-location claims; its spatial system is replaceable.

assumptions.statement: Road, heritage, building-condition, fire, utility, FAR and height controls are unavailable as cleared project files.
assumptions.impact: Routes, programme envelopes, phases and retain-adapt-remove choices remain conceptual.

assumptions.statement: All 12 scenarios retain an identified staff role, ordinary non-AI completion, human sign-off and a removal condition.
assumptions.impact: The 100% coverage metrics test protocol completeness, not real-world quality.

assumptions.statement: Six external cases are used only to extract bounded operating and public-realm mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No foreign scale, budget, legal arrangement, brand, image or performance result is transferred.

assumptions.statement: Shenzhen and Chongqing are method references subordinate to the repository brief and Beijing conditions.
assumptions.impact: Scenario-led delivery and legible continuous routes may inform method; skyline, density, mountain form, branding and claims are not copied.

assumptions.statement: Six staff-side capabilities are existing product categories, but each deployment still requires procurement, security, accessibility, source and operator acceptance.
assumptions.impact: No tool moves beyond shadow mode simply because its technology category is mature.

assumptions.statement: Twelve service cells, twelve reuse-first envelopes, ten links and three public rooms form an exact-cover conceptual operating structure.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate spatial logic but do not establish parcels, rights, heritage impacts or construction quantities.

assumptions.statement: Four tool modes and zero automated public decisions are proposed procurement and operating rules, not an adopted government procedure.
assumptions.impact: Authorized owners must approve sources, roles, records, thresholds and removal before any staff-assisted use.

assumptions.statement: CNY 0.85-1.95 million is a pre-feasibility first-100-day concept range based on seven small packages, not a quote or commitment.
assumptions.impact: Verify quantities, tax, market quotations, staffing, utilities and lifecycle OPEX before funding or procurement.

assumptions.statement: An authorized 8-12 week ordinary human-service baseline precedes tool value and error targets.
assumptions.impact: The 20% staff-time value gate is a design threshold; no performance result is claimed before field evidence.

assumptions.statement: Official park, heritage, renewal and public-space pages improve local grounding but do not supply the official submission boundary or site survey.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses verified principles while avoiding exact overlap, parcel, engineering or approval claims.

assumptions.statement: The 140-case preopening rehearsal checks contract completeness and deterministic stop/reversion behavior in the package; it is not a field test.
assumptions.impact: Opening still requires official geometry, operator authorization, real staff, engineering checks and representative-user rehearsal.

assumptions.statement: The illustrative 24-hour anchor plus two 8-hour pop-up weekly windows produce 48 frontline staff-hours after a 20% handover/training/relief allowance.
assumptions.impact: This is a resource formula, not an approved roster, wage, operating budget or service promise.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap vector context is used only to help reviewers orient the provisional concept figures.
assumptions.impact: No official boundary, parcel, ownership, heritage control, planning control or engineering conclusion is derived from OSM.
